mcp_tools.name: network_exposure_audit
mcp_tools.title: Network exposure audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a network-exposure evidence manifest (inventory, declared public endpoints and sending domains, segmentation, TLS, DNS/email authentication, edge/access and egress posture); get a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed plaintext-endpoint, public-admin-endpoint and email-authentication checks that name offending endpoints, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The network-exposure evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and endpoints[]/domains[] schemas).

inventory.description: Inventory evidence (current, every public endpoint owned, none unlisted).

endpoints.description: Declared endpoints: {host, port, protocol, service, zone, owner, listed}.

segmentation.description: Segmentation evidence (trust zones separated, admin plane separate, default-deny).

tls.description: TLS evidence (no plaintext, valid certs, HSTS, minimum version).

domains.description: Declared sending domains with SPF / DKIM / DMARC posture.

edge.description: Edge evidence (WAF/CDN in front, rate limits).

access.description: Access evidence (admin via authenticated path only, no unauthenticated tunnels, no default credentials).

egress.description: Egress evidence (outbound allowlist, unexpected egress logged).

evidence.description: Evidence-review evidence (logged events, reviewed on change/incident).

expect.notes: All fields present and compliant with security policy.
